args.description: Pixel art sprite sheet of 12 cute zoo animals on a transparent background, arranged in a loose grid of 4 columns by 3 rows with clear empty space between the animals. Every animal is a separate full-body sprite in side view facing right, drawn at one consistent pixel scale with realistic relative sizes (elephant and rhinoceros largest, giraffe tallest, penguin and monkey small). Animals in order: elephant, giraffe, zebra, male lion with mane, tiger, giant panda sitting, hippopotamus, pink flamingo, penguin, monkey, rhinoceros, brown bear. Painterly pixel art with soft multi-tone shading, dark outline in a darker shade of the animal, small soft ground shadow under each animal.

style_image.usage_description: Style reference for animals: painterly pixel art, shading, outline and shadow. Match this look and pixel scale (animals about 30-40 pixels long).

args.description: Pixel art sprite sheet of 12 tiny zoo animals on a transparent background, grid of 4 columns by 3 rows, each animal fitting in its own cell of about 32 by 40 pixels with empty space between cells. Very small sprites: every animal only about 22 to 30 pixels long, full body, side view facing right, one consistent pixel scale with realistic relative sizes (elephant and rhinoceros largest, giraffe tallest, penguin and monkey smallest). Order: elephant, giraffe, zebra, male lion, tiger, giant panda sitting, hippopotamus, pink flamingo, penguin, monkey, rhinoceros, brown bear. Painterly pixel art, soft shading, dark outline in a darker shade of the animal, tiny soft ground shadow.

style_image.usage_description: Style reference only: painterly shading, outline and ground shadow. Draw the animals MUCH SMALLER than in the reference (about 25 px long).

args.description: Pixel art sprite sheet of 16 small park decorations for a zoo on a transparent background, grid of 4 columns by 4 rows, each object in its own cell of 32 by 32 pixels with space between cells. Isometric three-quarter view from above, like a city-builder game, each object only about 16 to 28 pixels wide. Row 1: four different park benches (natural wood, green painted metal, grey stone, colorful striped). Row 2: iron street lamp, green trash bin, drinking fountain, wooden signpost with two arrows. Row 3: picnic table with a red umbrella, flower planter box with colorful flowers, small stone fountain with water, trimmed green hedge block. Row 4: statue on a stone pedestal, ice cream kiosk with striped awning, potted palm, bunch of colorful balloons on a stand. Same pixel art style as the reference: soft shading, dark outline in a darker shade of each object, light and cheerful colors.

style_image.usage_description: Style reference: isometric props of the same game, same outline, shading and scale. Match this look and pixel size.

args.description: Pixel art sprite sheet of 9 zoo buildings on a transparent background, grid of 3 columns by 3 rows, each building in its own cell of about 85 by 85 pixels with clear space between cells. Isometric three-quarter view from above, like a city-builder game, each building about 56 to 72 pixels wide, standing on the ground, no ground tile. Row 1: savanna lodge (round African hut with thatched roof and wooden veranda), big elephant barn (wide wooden barn with large arched doors), Asian panda pavilion (red pillars, curved green tiled pagoda roof, bamboo). Row 2: arctic penguin house (icy blue building with snowy roof and round window), jungle monkey tree house (wooden house on stilts with palm leaf roof and rope bridge), modern aquarium (white building with big glass front and a blue fish sign). Row 3: modern cafe (flat roof, large glass windows, striped awning, small tables), colorful gift shop (timber building with striped awning and balloons), glass aviary (iron framed glass dome greenhouse). Same pixel art style as the reference: soft shading, dark outline in a darker shade of each object, light cheerful colors, small windows and doors.

style_image.usage_description: Style reference: same isometric game, same outline, shading and cheerful colors. Draw buildings in this look (the reference items are small props; buildings are larger).

style_image.usage_description: Style reference: same game, same buildings look, outline, shading, colors and scale. Keep exactly this look.
